name: Heretic's Bane
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 193
Aura moderate enchantment CL 8th
Slot none; Price 32,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This sturdy wooden staff is crowned by a holy symbol, surrounded by wicked barbs of metal. The staff allows use of the following spells:
Castigate (1 charge; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Command (1 charge)
Zone of truth (1 charge)
Denounce (2 charges; Advanced Player’s Guide)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, castigate, command, denounce, zone of truth; Cost 16,000 gp
